title: 2023 Bowman Chrome - Prospects Mojo Refractor #BCP-212 Brady House (RC)
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Bowman Chrome baseball trading card featuring Brady House of the Washington Nationals. This particular card is from the Mojo Refractor parallel set, making it a rare and collectible item for fans and collectors. As a rookie card from the Prospects insert set, it adds value to any sports trading card collection, especially for those interested in Major League Baseball memorabilia.
